findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/GeneralLinearGroup/Basic.lean:63-74 defines `coe_ofLinearEquiv`, `ofLinearEquiv_mul`, `ofLinearEquiv_inv` and (l.48) `coe_toLinearEquiv` in `LinearMap.GeneralLinearGroup`. SemisimplePoint.lean:140 uses `GeneralLinearGroup.ofLinearEquiv_pow` (TauCeti) and l.155 `LinearMap.GeneralLinearGroup.ofLinearEquiv_mul` (Mathlib) in the same proof block. Repo precedent for root-namespace Mathlib extensions: TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/Determinant.lean:71,105 (`namespace AlternatingMap`, `namespace LinearMap` outside `namespace TauCeti`, which starts at l.174).
findings.fix: Declare these four in the root `LinearMap.GeneralLinearGroup` namespace beside their Mathlib siblings, as `TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/Determinant.lean` already does for `AlternatingMap`/`LinearMap` lemmas; keep `TauCeti.GeneralLinearGroup` for TauCeti-defined material (`IsSemisimple`, `semisimplePart`, `prodMap`, `tensorProduct`). While moving, rename `coe_ofLinearEquiv_toLinearMap` so it does not sit one suffix away from Mathlib's differently-stated `coe_ofLinearEquiv`.
findings.issue: `toLinearEquiv_ofLinearEquiv`, `toLinearEquiv_toLinearMap`, `coe_ofLinearEquiv_toLinearMap` and `ofLinearEquiv_pow` are statements purely about Mathlib's `LinearMap.GeneralLinearGroup.ofLinearEquiv`/`toLinearEquiv`, but are declared in `TauCeti.GeneralLinearGroup`. That splits one API family across two namespaces under the same relative name: `GeneralLinearGroup.ofLinearEquiv_mul`/`_inv`/`coe_ofLinearEquiv` resolve to Mathlib, `GeneralLinearGroup.ofLinearEquiv_pow`/`coe_ofLinearEquiv_toLinearMap` to TauCeti, and which one you get depends on the `open`s in scope.

findings.evidence: Adjoin.lean:13 `# Algebra generated by a unit`; l.42 `theorem coe_inv_mem_adjoin (u : Aˣ)` — hypotheses are `[Field K] [Ring A] [Algebra K A] [FiniteDimensional K A]`, no GL group; l.74-97 declare four `GeneralLinearGroup` lemmas, none of which mention `Algebra.adjoin`, and none of which appear in `Main declarations`.
findings.fix: Split the file: put `coe_inv_mem_adjoin` under a name matching its subject (e.g. `TauCeti/RingTheory/Adjoin/Unit.lean`), and the `ofLinearEquiv`/`toLinearEquiv` coercion lemmas in a `GeneralLinearGroup/Basic.lean`-style file, with each module's title and `Main declarations` listing everything it declares.
findings.issue: The module name misdescribes its contents in both directions: the only `adjoin` result (`Units.coe_inv_mem_adjoin`) is about units of an arbitrary finite-dimensional algebra and never mentions a general linear group, while the four `GeneralLinearGroup` declarations are coercion lemmas with nothing to do with `Algebra.adjoin`. The header `# Algebra generated by a unit` and the `## Main declarations` list (l.23-24) cover only the first half.

summary: Four lemmas about Mathlib's own `LinearMap.GeneralLinearGroup.ofLinearEquiv`/`toLinearEquiv` are placed in the parallel `TauCeti.GeneralLinearGroup` namespace, so the same relative names split across two namespaces (and the new file already uses both spellings within 15 lines). The new file's name also describes neither half of its contents.
